text:
sanjay: Bringing up Avalanche15b int4 on pool-az1. After ~48h we saw two burst OOMs for requests using max_new_tokens > 128. Not a steady leak, looks like fragmentation/cold-start spikes. Anyone seen this with big int4 models?

ellie: Yes, int4 can fragment at warmup. Are these long prefixes or highly variable session lengths? Also: are we running prefix cache + aggressive prefetch?

mike: Node logs show cudaMalloc failed and slab freelist dropped quickly. Sample: runtime cudaMalloc OOM, freelist after alloc 3.2MB (was 12.8MB), kv_cache entries low. The OOMed requests had max_new_tokens=256 and avg prefix ~900 tokens.

lee: That freelist flip suggests churn of small allocations. Quick mitigations: lower per-route default max_new_tokens to 128, reduce prefetch_slots for the model, and enable a soft-throttle when estimated total_seq > 1024.

sanjay: Plan: run a canary with per-route override + prefetch slot reserve on 2 nodes in az1. @mike add slab freelist histograms at 30s cadence.

mike: Added histograms. I reproduced locally with curl invoking avalanche15b-int4 with max_new_tokens=256 and saw OOM after ~200 requests.

ellie: Canary manifest idea: model avalanche15b-int4 defaults max_new_tokens 128, batch_window_ms 12, prefetch_slots 2, kv_cache_prefetch false; slo_guards soft_throttle_tokens 512. Keeps batching but reduces speculative allocations.

lee: Alternate quick test: disable continuous batching for 1h on the canary. If fragmentation stops, batching is likely the culprit.

sanjay: Rolling canary c-20260323-1 to pool-az1 (2 nodes) with the defaults above.

deploy-bot: Canary c-20260323-1 applied to pool-az1 (2 nodes). Observability hooks enabled.

mike: After 2k mixed requests on canary: 0 OOMs. p95 latency +12-18ms. Slab histograms show fewer small fragments; freelist stable ~11MB median. kv hit_rate improved.

ellie: If canary holds for 6h propose making per-route default 128 for avalanche15b on dedicated pool and add fallback: if request.max_new_tokens > 128 and pool free_mem < 20% then return 429 with guidance.

sanjay: Filing a short on-call runbook (rollback, pin float variant, escalate infra). I'll update onboarding checklist to require frag/slot sanity and recommended max_new_tokens.

lee: Long term task: benchmark kernel affinity and small-allocation caching for int4; may need per-model allocator tunables. Filing MLINFRA-872.

mike: TL;DR immediate fix = canary with max_new_tokens default 128 and prefetch_slots=2. Monitor slab histograms, kv hit rate, OOM count.

sanjay: Thanks all — updating docs and checklist. :thumbsup:
